status.en: 56 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% more than the week before, most of them in Tehran, Gulf Of Oman and Minab.
status.nb: 56 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Teheran, Omanbukta og Minab.

summary.en: Iran launched a missile that struck a building in Tel Aviv while the United States carried out fresh strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island and disabled a commercial vessel attempting to run a blockade in the Gulf of Oman. The IRGC announced that its self-imposed limit on ballistic-missile range has been lifted and that it is building underground sites for weapons production and storage. Tehran delivered a secret Khamenei message to Putin as Moscow pushes a gas-pipeline deal and sent a nuclear proposal to the United States via Qatar. Houthis damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in Riyadh. There were 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
